subject: Q4 rollcalls: pipeline playbook, forecast consolidation & account roll-calls
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-10-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Q4 rollcalls: pipeline playbook, forecast consolidation & account roll-calls

Team —

As discussed in last week's leadership sync, we need a concise playbook for the QBR readouts and account-by-account roll-calls next week. Goal: finish forecasts and owner talking points by EOD Friday so we can have the exec deck ready Monday.

Ask (owners in parens):
- Consolidated forecast CSV with top 25 accounts + risk tag (Rishi)
- 2-slide account summary for each top-10 account: bullets on recent activity, ask, blockers, next step (Marissa)
- Confirm exec attendees and preferred slot for the customer roll-calls (Laura)

Accounts to prioritize: AtlasHealth (close this quarter), Kiln AI (pilot -> expansion), Meridian Labs (procurement in legal), Tesseract Systems (renewal).

I attached a QBR_prep_template.xlsx — use the Account Summary tab. Please drop your deliverables into the shared Drive folder (link below) and add HubSpot deal notes.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBRPrepDecks
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deal/ATL-2026-0392

I'll coordinate scheduling with the customer contacts once we have the summaries.

Thanks —
Mina
Mina Haddad
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
Attachment: QBR_prep_template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Mina —

Uploading two starter account summaries (AtlasHealth, Kiln AI) and calling out the immediate asks below. I used the template and kept each summary to a single page.

AtlasHealth (owner: Marissa)
- Current forecast: $420k ARR (weighted 60%)
- Recent: completed security review; procurement asked for updated SOW and updated retention terms
- Blocker: finance wants an invoicing cadence and SOC-2 evidence beyond what's in the portal
- Immediate ask: procurement meeting scheduled week of 11/8; need final pricing approval and DocuSign link

Kiln AI (owner: Marissa)
- Current forecast: $185k ARR (pilot -> expansion)
- Recent: successful pilot metrics shared; legal reviewing standard T&Cs
- Blocker: need a clear success metric and license tiers for expansion

Attachments: AtlasHealth_account_summary.pdf (single-page summary), Kiln_AI_notes.docx (stub)

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Lead, East | Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-10-30T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q4 rollcalls: pipeline playbook, forecast consolidation & account roll-calls

All —

Shared the consolidated pipeline CSV in the Drive folder: pipeline_consolidation_20261101.csv. Notes from consolidation run:
- Top-line delta vs last forecast: +$110k in weighted ARR (driven by AtlasHealth movement from 50%->60%)
- Risk tags applied: red (legal/procurement delays), yellow (needs exec engagement), green (on-track)
- Meridian Labs moved to red due to payment terms negotiation; recommend senior AE + solutions engineer on roll-call

Consolidation assumptions included: 60% weight for POC wins, 25% attrition buffer for long-tail deals, and no additional upsells factored. If teams want to include contingent upsell scenarios, send me the numbers by Thursday.

File: pipeline_consolidation_20261101.csv (spreadsheet stub)

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

Thanks, Mina/Marissa —

Appreciate the transparency and the one-pagers. We can do a roll-call for AtlasHealth on Tuesday 11/9 at 10am PT. A couple items from our side:
- Procurement would like an updated SOW reflecting a quarterly billing option (we're evaluating cashflow)
- Security: can you provide the SOC-2 addendum and a point contact for audit questions?

We'll loop in our finance lead once you send the updated proposal. Please send the DocuSign link for signature once terms are finalized.

Best,
Sana Kapoor
Director, Product & Partnerships | AtlasHealth

AtlasHealth action matrix (owners):
- Final pricing & billing cadence (Marissa) — due 11/5
- SOC-2 addendum & security point contact (Rishi to coordinate with Security team) — due 11/4
- Updated SOW with quarterly billing option (Marissa + Legal) — draft by 11/3
- DocuSign setup and routing (Revenue ops) — ready by 11/6

I'll invite Laura to the roll-call for the exec readout (Laura: can you join for the first 20 minutes?). We're keeping the roll-call to 30 minutes: 10m recap, 10m customer Q&A, 10m next steps.

I've uploaded QBR_action_matrix.xlsx with owners and deadlines to the Drive folder. https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBRPrepDecks
